branchDescription: KPIs for this company and its sibling branches.

failDescription: Something went wrong while fetching group KPIs. Try again.

help.title: About Group dashboard
help.overview: Group dashboard aggregates KPIs across branch companies that share a parent organisation. Headquarters sees the group total plus a per-branch table. A branch sees itself and siblings. This is a read-model, not a place to edit units.

sections.title: KPIs
items: Revenue, commissions, active leases, open snags.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Computed at a timestamp shown in the header — refresh reloads the aggregation.
Child companies must have their parent company set to this organisation or they will not appear.
Each branch’s operational work still happens in that company’s own Real Estate menus after you switch company.
It is not Overview (one company) and not Dashboard (one edifice).

sections.title: Related records
items: Rolls up Units, Sales, Commissions, Leases, Snags per company.
